title: BUGFIX — Fix FFmpeg subtitle force_style comma escaping in caption agent
rationale: agents/scs001-caption/index.ts line 151: force_style='FontSize=24,PrimaryColour=...' — FFmpeg 8.1 does not correctly parse single-quoted filter option values containing commas. The commas are interpreted as filter option separators causing 'No option name near' parse error. Fix: remove single-quote quoting and use \, backslash-escaped commas instead, which FFmpeg's filter parser treats as literal commas. This caused every production-mode caption burn-in to fail (fallback to copy without captions).

tasks.description: Fix agents/scs001-caption/index.ts line 151: change vfArg to use \, escaped commas in force_style instead of single-quote quoting. Remove f='...' quoting around srtPath (unnecessary since path has no special chars). New vfArg: subtitles=${srtPath}:force_style=FontSize=24\,PrimaryColour=&H00FFFFFF\,OutlineColour=&H00000000\,Outline=2\,Alignment=2\,MarginV=80
